note: Top navigation bar -- renders: GitLab logo, search box, 'New project' button, dashboard shortcut labels (Issues, Merge requests, To do list, Help), and user avatar; all labels are fixed platform vocabulary

Project sidebar navigation -- renders: fixed section labels (Project information, Repository, Issues, Merge requests, Pipelines, Deployments, Infrastructure, Monitor, Analytics, Wiki, Snippets, Settings); the project name in the context header is user-defined and subtracted
Breadcrumb navigation -- renders: user-defined project and group names; treated as trusted navigation chrome per calibration for this site type
Merge request state filter tabs -- renders: Opened, Merged, Closed, All
New merge request button -- renders: 'New merge request'
View toggle controls -- renders: list/board view switcher icons
New merge request button (secondary) -- renders: 'New merge request'
Filter form container -- renders: search input, history dropdown, and sort controls; the input value is user-generated but the container structure and labels are platform chrome
Sort controls -- renders: 'Sort by' dropdown and reverse sort button
